business.name: Quiznos
business.full_address: 201 N Los Angeles St STE 22, Los Angeles, CA 90012, USA
business.editorial_summary: Known for toasted, build-your-own subs, this counter-serve chain also sells soups, salads & more.

reviews.review: I stopped by here for lunch because I was across the street being a juror for Jury Duty. I wanted something close and I saw this Quiznos was across the street so I figure to come here to try it. This place is not really hidden inside the Los Angeles Mall, you just walk down the stairs and you'll see it in the corner. They weren't that busy during lunch time so I was able to basically walked in and place my order. I got the Ultimate Turkey Breast 8in sandwich and it was pretty decent. They don't give that much turkey breast like subway but it is what it is. I ate my food inside the store because it was covered and had AC inside. The customer service I received was good, I didn't have any issues during my experience.

One of the last Quiznos left in LA. And honestly, its a shame because the quality and flavors are incomparable. The hours are terrible and inaccurate. They were closed a whole hour before the time on google. Very disappointing.

This is supposed to be a meat ball. The last bite of meat ball sub was grainny and very dry. I don't think it's from toasting process. I think the meat ball was in the container for long time. I hope I wouldn't get sick from it. Last time I ever go to this place.
